name: GlassLoadingSkeleton
material_impl: Mixed. Card/dashboard layouts wrap in OptimizedGlass but override background/border/boxShadow inline with hard-coded rgba (lines 136-142, 310-316). Every bone is a bespoke div with a hard-coded double linear-gradient + rgba border/shadow (getSkeletonStyle, lines 83-91) plus glass-backdrop-blur-md on every bone (line 79) -> N backdrop-filter layers per skeleton. Shimmer overlay uses color-mix on --glass-white (line 400) but class glass-animate-glass-shimmer has no CSS definition anywhere in src/styles or dist (verified by rg) so the overlay is a static skewed band.
motion: Motion primitive fadeIn wrapper; pulse via glass-animate-pulse (no CSS definition found in src/styles); shimmer class undefined. Reduced motion IS wired via useMotionPreferenceContext (lines 62-66) and gates both animate and shimmer.
a11y: role=status, aria-busy, aria-live=polite, default aria-label 'Loading content' (lines 382-386). Good. Bones are not aria-hidden but are empty divs.
api: forwardRef, but ref + ...props go to the inner div while className goes to the outer Motion wrapper (lines 376-389) - split passthrough is surprising. Variant list (default/card/list/table/form/dashboard) is a layout preset menu, table hard-codes 4 columns (line 239). Exports GlassSkeletonText/Card/List/Table names that collide with GlassSkeleton.tsx and GlassSkeletonLoader.tsx exports. Dead export skeletonAnimationCSS 'should be added to globals.css' (lines 442-456). Unused imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast/ANIMATION/useReducedMotion.
ssr: use client; no window at module scope; Motion import only.
fake_complexity: 'Premium shimmer overlay' (line 393) references a non-existent animation class, so it does not shimmer.
target: Single GlassSkeleton primitive (shape bones) + GlassLoadingState (composition presets)
justification: This is one of three independent skeleton systems (GlassSkeleton, GlassSkeletonLoader, GlassLoadingSkeleton) with conflicting compound export names. It has the best a11y wiring of the three (role=status + reduced motion) but its shimmer and pulse classes do not exist in the stylesheet, and stacking backdrop blur on every bone is expensive for a placeholder. The certification screenshot shows bones at luminance >=229 on a 255 white canvas, i.e. effectively invisible grey-on-white. Keep its a11y contract and layout presets, fold into one skeleton API.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-data-display-glassloadingskeleton/desktop.png: pixel analysis min luminance in component band 229-245, saturation 0

name: GlassLoadingState
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass with tokenized props (elevation level1, intensity subtle, tint neutral, border subtle) and no inline color overrides (lines 37-49). Cleanest material usage in the shard. Skeleton bones use glass-bg-white/12 (defined).
motion: Spinner relies on class glass-animate-spin (line 57) which has NO CSS definition in src/styles or dist (verified) - the Loader2 icon is static. No reduced-motion branch needed since nothing animates, but that is accidental.
a11y: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-busy (lines 40-42); icon aria-hidden; progress variant has role=progressbar with valuenow but no accessible name (lines 83-89).
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, variant spinner|skeleton|progress, clamped progress. Simple and coherent.
fake_complexity: None, but progress fill uses glass-bg-primary which is undefined in the stylesheet (line 91) so the progress variant renders an empty track.
target: Canonical loading-state composition; absorb skeleton presets from GlassLoadingSkeleton
justification: Best-structured file in the loading cluster: a small forwardRef wrapper over OptimizedGlass with no hard-coded material. But two of its three variants are broken because the utility classes they depend on (glass-animate-spin, glass-bg-primary) do not exist, and it has no test and no certification screenshot, so nothing caught it. Fix the class contract, add an accessible name to the progressbar, add reduced-motion-aware spin, and make this the single loading-state entry point.

name: GlassMetricChip
material_impl: OptimizedGlass then fully overridden by a module-level inline style with hard-coded white gradient, slate border, shadows, and it force-overrides theme text tokens (--glass-text-primary etc.) to dark slate rgba (lines 7-18). That pins the chip to light mode; in dark theme it renders dark text on a translucent white pill.
motion: None.
a11y: intent conveyed only via aria-label on the value span (line 58); no visual intent styling at all - intent success/warning/danger renders identically. delta has no direction semantics. Each text span wrapped in its own ContrastGuard (3 per chip).
api: No forwardRef, no ...rest/style passthrough, only className. label/value required in type yet defaulted. intent naming (default/success/warning/danger) differs from GlassProgress (success/warning/error) and StatusDot (ok/warn/error).
fake_complexity: intent prop is cosmetic-only in the a11y layer; no visual difference.
target: GlassChip / GlassBadge with a 'metric' slot layout (label, value, delta)
justification: A pill with three text spans; its only distinguishing props (intent, delta) produce no visual change, and it hard-overrides theme text tokens so it cannot follow dark mode. Screenshot shows a small grey pill with faint text on white (content band min luminance near 231 on mobile). The library already has GlassChip, GlassBadge and three dashboard stat cards; this belongs as a GlassChip layout, not a separate component.

name: GlassMetricsGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root and cards but each overridden with three hard-coded inline surface objects (metricsSurfaceStyle/metricsCardSurfaceStyle/metricsInsetSurfaceStyle, lines 116-144) that also force light-mode text tokens. Every card also adds glass-backdrop-blur-md + glass-surface-dark/40 classes that fight the inline white gradient (line 431). Nested glass-in-glass (root -> card -> search inset).
motion: Motion fadeIn root + slideUp per card with index*100ms stagger (lines 723-731) - with 12 metrics the last card waits 1.2s. Reduced motion respected via MotionPreferenceContext (lines 624-628, 725-729). Hover scale uses Tailwind hover:scale-[1.02] (no glass equivalent). Sound feedback via useGlassSound on click and on every auto-refresh tick (lines 193, 442).
a11y: Clickable cards get role=button + tabIndex=0 but no onKeyDown, so Enter/Space do nothing (lines 439-450). Non-clickable cards are still clickable via onMetricClick yet tabIndex=-1. Search input has no label (lines 649-659). Emoji used as icons/buttons ('🔍', '🔄 Refresh', '📊 Export', lines 661, 681, 698). Trend up and down both glass-text-primary - no color/shape distinction beyond arrow glyph (lines 325-326). Status colors all identical (lines 263-269).
api: forwardRef + className/style. Large prop surface where many props are ignored: layout.columns and layout.responsive are discarded in favour of auto-fit minmax (lines 590-598); status prop has no effect; searchQuery is only initial state (not controlled, line 185); exportable offers only JSON despite csv|json|png type (line 687); currency hard-coded USD/en-US (line 292); bytes format breaks on 0 (log(0) -> -Infinity, line 298).
ssr: use client; NodeJS.Timeout type; no module-scope DOM.
fake_complexity: Filtering/sort/search/export/auto-refresh are real but thin; 'priority' indicator uses Tailwind classes top-2 right-2 bg-current opacity-60 that are not in the glass stylesheet, so priority dots are mispositioned.
target: Compose from a single GlassStatCard + GlassSparkline inside a responsive grid layout primitive
justification: Kitchen-sink dashboard widget that re-implements stat card and sparkline instead of composing existing ones, ignores half its declared props, and has a keyboard-inoperable role=button. The screenshot shows only faint text with cards nearly invisible on a white canvas (component band saturation 0-2, card surfaces above luminance 225). A premium metrics surface needs real status color, tabular numerals, delta semantics and a composable card; rebuild on top of a consolidated stat card.

name: GlassNotificationCenter
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with inline hard-coded surface (rgba(255,255,255,0.30) + 0.62 white border, lines 18-24) overriding tokens. Duplicate local + module-level getTypeStyles (lines 172-196 and 435-459). Unicode glyphs for type icons ('✓ ✕ ⚠ ℹ') instead of the library icon set used by GlassToast.
motion: Motion wrapper per item with delay but the computed getMotionPreset() is never passed to Motion (lines 259-276) - the 'animation' prop is dead. Progress bar uses @keyframes shrink injected at MODULE SCOPE into document.head (lines 469-478). No reduced-motion handling for shrink.
a11y: Container aria-live=polite (good). Close buttons are icon-only '✕' with no aria-label (lines 335-341, 420-426). 'Clear All' is an OptimizedGlass div with onClick - not a button, not keyboard reachable (lines 234-252). Action buttons lack type=button.
api: forwardRef. autoHideDelay prop destructured but never used (line 151) - provider uses its own default. animation prop dead. Container positioning classes 'fixed z-50 top-4 right-4' are unprefixed Tailwind and have no CSS definition in the shipped stylesheet (verified: no '.fixed', '.top-4'), so in consumer apps the center renders in document flow, not as an overlay. GlassNotificationProvider puts data-glass-component on a Context.Provider (no-op, line 126). setState typed as any.
ssr: Module-scope document.createElement/appendChild side effect on import (lines 469-478), guarded by typeof document but still a side-effect import that breaks tree-shaking/sideEffects:false assumptions.
fake_complexity: animation presets and autoHideDelay advertised but inert.
target: One toast/notification system (GlassToastProvider + queue) with a notification-center list view
justification: Third independent toast/notification stack in the library (alongside data-display/GlassToast and feedback/GlassToast) with its own context, its own id generation and its own timers. Several advertised props do nothing, its overlay positioning depends on Tailwind classes the package does not ship, close controls are unlabeled, and Clear All is not a button. Merge into a single notifications engine; keep the 'center' as a list presentation over the same store.

name: GlassProgress
tests: src/components/data-display/GlassProgress.test.tsx (129 lines, includes reduced-motion and fill-vs-track contrast tests)
material_impl: Track is OptimizedGlass overridden inline with hard-coded white gradient + slate border (lines 241-248). Fill uses --glass-theme-text-secondary as its color (lines 163-170) - a text token as a fill, so every variant is the same grey. variantClasses map is entirely empty strings (lines 154-161): success/warning/error/gradient/primary are no-ops. Classes glass-sheen, glass-bg-stripes, bg-stripes, animate-progress-indeterminate have no CSS definition, so striped and indeterminate do not render as designed. shape value 'glass-radius-md' is a find/replace artifact leaking into the public type (line 41).
motion: Width transition with configurable duration; reduced motion via MotionPreferenceContext (lines 113-117). useEffect deps omit shouldAnimate (line 134). Indeterminate = full-width bar with animate-pulse (pulse class exists only in storybook-utility-shim).
a11y: role=progressbar with valuenow/min/max and aria-label (lines 249-254). Top label renders {label} not labelContent, so showValue without label produces an empty left span (line 220). aria-describedby points to a label id that does not exist when labelPosition=inline (line 254). Inline label uses mix-blend-difference inside ContrastGuard - unpredictable contrast.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. Both 'data-testid' and camelCase dataTestId props (lines 78-81) - test plumbing in public API. Variant names inconsistent with siblings.
ssr: use client; mounted gate avoids hydration jump.
fake_complexity: Six variants that are visually identical; 'gradient' has no gradient; 'striped' has no stripe CSS.
target: GlassProgress (linear) with real intent tokens; split circular/steps into own files
justification: Progress is a core primitive, so it stays, but the current implementation has no working variants, no working stripes/indeterminate, and a leaked 'glass-radius-md' enum. The certification screenshot shows a light grey line on white (component band min luminance 240 on desktop), i.e. the fill is barely distinguishable. Rebuild around intent tokens, a proper indeterminate keyframe with reduced-motion fallback, and a liquid-glass track.

name: CircularProgress
material_impl: Plain SVG; no glass at all. Uses Tailwind-style stroke-primary/stroke-success/stroke-destructive (lines 392-397) which have no CSS definition. Glow overlay uses glass-stroke-white-opacity-10 (undefined) and no stroke attribute.
motion: setTimeout to animate value; class string literally contains 'transition-all var(--glass-motion-duration-normal) var(...)' as class names (line 439) - not CSS. No reduced motion. Rotation class 'glass---rotate-90' (triple dash typo, line 410) is undefined, so the arc starts at 3 o'clock.
a11y: No role=progressbar, no aria-valuenow, no label.
api: forwardRef; size sm-xl.
fake_complexity: Indeterminate uses animate-spin on a circle element without transform-box, spinning around the SVG origin.
target: GlassProgressRing (own file, exported, with progressbar semantics)
justification: Internal, unexported and visibly broken (wrong start angle, colorless strokes, class names that are actually CSS values). Either rebuild as a proper exported ring or delete; a premium system needs a ring, so rebuild.

name: StepProgress
material_impl: No glass. Mix of glass-* and shadcn/Tailwind tokens (bg-primary, bg-background, bg-muted, ring-2 ring-primary/20, bg-primary-foreground) (lines 595-631). Completed and current both 'bg-primary ... glass-text-primary' so the check icon is same-color-on-same-color.
motion: Dynamic Tailwind class 'duration-[${ms}ms]' built at runtime (line 592) - cannot be generated by any JIT; inert.
a11y: Clickable step indicator is a div with onClick, no role/tabIndex/keyboard (lines 589-606). No aria-current on current step. No list semantics.
api: Function component, no forwardRef.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Unexported, unstoried, inaccessible duplicate of the wizard step indicators that relies on a different design system's tokens. Delete and point to the canonical stepper.

name: GlassSchemaViewer
material_impl: None of its own; delegates entirely to GlassJSONViewer with an extra className (lines 21-29).
motion: Inherited.
a11y: Inherited from GlassJSONViewer.
api: No forwardRef, no rest props; renames value->schema. No schema-aware features (types, required, descriptions).
fake_complexity: Name implies a JSON-Schema viewer; it is an alias of the JSON tree viewer with zero schema semantics.
justification: A 32-line rename wrapper that inflates the component count without adding behavior and misleads by name. Deprecate in favour of GlassJSONViewer; if a real schema viewer is wanted, build it with property/type/required columns.

name: GlassSkeleton
material_impl: OptimizedGlass per bone (performanceMode low) but overridden with hard-coded rgba border + three-layer box-shadow (lines 54-66). Each bone is a full glass surface with shadow - heavier than a placeholder needs. Variant enum contains 'glass-radius-md' (find/replace artifact, line 15) as a public value.
motion: Injects a <style> keyframes tag on EVERY instance render (lines 144, 189). Applies both Tailwind 'animate-pulse' class and an inline skeleton-pulse animation (lines 170, 176, 204, 210) - double animation. 'wave' translates the entire bone off-screen (-100% to 100%) rather than sweeping a highlight (lines 44-51, 127-134) - visibly wrong. No reduced-motion handling at all.
a11y: No role, no aria-hidden, no aria-busy; consumer must wrap. Fine for a bone primitive but should be aria-hidden.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. Avatar/Button/Card/Table/List helpers; Card/Table/List re-exported from data-display index as *Compact to dodge name collisions with GlassSkeletonLoader. Helpers lack forwardRef. 'width' handled as Array in code though typed string|number (line 147).
ssr: use client; inline <style> per instance duplicates CSS in SSR output.
fake_complexity: 'wave' animation is broken by design.
target: Canonical GlassSkeleton (bone primitive) - keep this name, absorb the other two
justification: Has the right shape for the canonical bone primitive (forwardRef, shape variants, 8 stories) but ships a broken wave, double pulse, per-instance style injection, no reduced motion, and a leaked enum value. The certification crop shows only the story headings; the bones themselves sit above luminance 215 on white and do not register. Make this the single skeleton primitive with a CSS-defined shimmer, aria-hidden bones, and reduced-motion fallback; delete the other two implementations.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-data-display-glassskeleton/desktop.png: only text labels exceed contrast threshold

name: GlassSkeletonLoader
material_impl: OptimizedGlass overridden with --glass-neutral-level2-surface + hard-coded rgba border/shadow (lines 161-169, 193-203). 'shimmer' and 'wave' set background to a flat surface var then animate background-position - no gradient means nothing visible moves (lines 116-133). Sheen overlay is the same flat surface color blurred, so invisible (lines 174-189). glass-depth-pulse keyframe animates box-shadow from X to X (lines 74-77) - a no-op.
motion: Uses useAccessibleAnimation for the main loader (line 94) - reduced motion honored there. GlassSkeletonText and GlassSkeletonCard hard-code 'glass-pulse 2s infinite' and ignore shouldAnimate (lines 256-275, 289) - reduced motion NOT honored. The glass-pulse keyframe is only injected by GlassSkeletonLoader's <style>, so standalone GlassSkeletonText/Card reference an undefined keyframe.
a11y: No role=status / aria-busy; aria-label on a generic div (line 158) is ignored by AT. This 'loader' is a pulsing circle + text, i.e. a spinner, not a skeleton.
api: React.FC wrapped in memo, no forwardRef, no rest props. loading/children toggle pattern. Exports GlassSkeletonText/GlassSkeletonCard which win the root export name over GlassSkeleton.tsx and GlassLoadingSkeleton.tsx versions (src/index.ts:347-351). Unused imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast/ANIMATION/useReducedMotion. Error boundary wrapping a placeholder.
ssr: mounted gate means children never render on the server even when loading=false (line 101) - SSR content flash.
fake_complexity: Four animation variants of which shimmer/wave/sheen produce no visible effect.
justification: Misnamed spinner whose advertised variants are no-ops, whose compound helpers break reduced motion and depend on keyframes injected by a sibling, and whose exported names shadow the other skeleton implementations at the package root. It blocks server rendering of children. Nothing here is worth keeping beyond what GlassLoadingState and GlassSkeleton already cover.

name: GlassSparkline
material_impl: Plain SVG path, no glass. Hard-coded default stroke '#70d6ff' (line 44) - not a token, low contrast on light backgrounds.
motion: None. Imports useReducedMotion/ANIMATION but never uses them (lines 8-9).
a11y: No role=img, no <title>, no aria-label/aria-hidden; decorative-or-informative is undecided. Default data [0,0] renders a flat line instead of nothing.
api: Function component, no forwardRef; spreads SVG attributes (good). compact/contained are aliases for the same thing (lines 17-26). No area fill gradient, no min/max/last-point markers, no smoothing.
fake_complexity: None - honest but minimal.
justification: Small, deterministic, SSR-safe and genuinely useful; it should be the one sparkline that GlassMetricsGrid and stat cards compose. Needs a tokenized stroke, optional area gradient and endpoint dot, forwardRef, and an accessible name or aria-hidden contract. Screenshot shows a thin light line (band min luminance 202) - readable but not premium.

name: GlassStatusDot
material_impl: Bare span with Tailwind palette classes bg-emerald-400/bg-amber-400/bg-red-400/bg-blue-400/bg-slate-400 (lines 22-31). Only bg-red-400 and bg-blue-400 exist (in storybook-utility-shim.css); emerald, amber and slate are not defined anywhere in src/styles or dist, so status ok (the default), warn and offline render as a transparent, invisible dot in consumer apps. No tokens.
motion: None; imports useReducedMotion/ANIMATION unused (lines 8-9). No 'busy' pulse despite the status name.
a11y: No role, no aria-label, no text alternative - status is conveyed by color only (WCAG 1.4.1 failure). Unused ContrastGuard imports.
api: No forwardRef, no rest props, size as raw number. Status naming ok/warn/error/busy/offline differs from every other intent enum in the library.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassBadge dot variant or a tokenized GlassStatusIndicator
justification: The default status renders invisible outside Storybook because its color class is not shipped, and it has no non-color affordance or accessible label. A status dot is trivial to do right (intent tokens, optional pulse for busy with reduced-motion fallback, sr-only label); rebuild it as part of the badge/status family.

name: GlassTimeline
material_impl: OptimizedGlass cards overridden with a very faint hard-coded white gradient (0.105 -> 0.018 alpha) and 0.18 white border (lines 12-20) - on light backgrounds the card edge is essentially invisible. Line/dot colors hard-coded rgba (lines 196, 215-216, 293, 312-313). Layout CSS injected via <style> per instance (lines 22-34, 395).
motion: None.
a11y: Vertical: proper ul/li (good) but root div has aria-label without a role (ignored, line 286). Horizontal: role=list/listitem on divs. item.onClick and item.disabled are declared in TimelineItem but never wired (lines 66-72) - no interactive items. ContrastGuard wraps every text node.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. timePosition 'left' declared but not implemented (lines 99, 365-389). Horizontal mode uses unprefixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 max-w-xs (undefined in stylesheet) so dots are mispositioned (line 208, 231). sizeClasses.container/line are empty strings. TimelineItemComponent is a stub with a comment 'Implementation would mirror...' (lines 423-462). data-testid only on vertical root.
ssr: Safe; inline style tag duplicated per instance.
fake_complexity: TimelineItemComponent is a placeholder; interactive items advertised in types only.
justification: Vertical mode is structurally sound (ul/li, responsive padding, min-width guards) and the screenshot shows three readable rows with title/subtitle/time, but cards are near-invisible on white (band min luminance ~200), horizontal mode depends on undefined Tailwind classes, and several advertised props are unimplemented. Worth polishing: tokenized card surface, working horizontal layout, wire onClick/disabled, delete the stub subcomponent.

name: GlassToast (+ GlassToastProvider, GlassToastViewport, useToast)
tests: src/components/data-display/GlassToast.test.tsx (191 lines, includes caller-owned live region test)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4/strong then overridden with near-transparent hard-coded white gradient (0.105->0.018) and 0.18 border (lines 23-33). On light backgrounds the toast is a faint outline; screenshot confirms (component band min luminance 156 desktop, saturation 0). All four types use the same secondary text color for icon and progress (lines 179-204, 244, 251) - success/error/warning are visually indistinguishable.
motion: Motion slideRight preset; no reduced-motion check in this file (useMotionPreferenceContext imported, unused, line 16). Progress interval ticks every ANIMATION.DURATION.fast/3 = 50ms but decrements assuming 100ms ticks (lines 157-166), so the toast self-dismisses at ~50% of duration. handleDismiss is called from inside a setState updater (side effect in reducer, line 161). Provider also schedules its own removal setTimeout (lines 321-325) - two competing timers; hover-pause only pauses the inner one.
a11y: Toast has no role=status/alert and the viewport is not a live region - screen readers are not notified by default (contrast: feedback/GlassToast.tsx:211-212 has role=status). Close button 44x44 with aria-label (good). Hotkey Alt+T focuses [data-toast-id] wrappers which are not focusable (no tabIndex, lines 378-382, 409-413). Success icon has aria-label but others don't.
api: GlassToast is React.FC (no forwardRef). Viewport positioning uses unprefixed 'fixed', 'top-4 right-4', 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2', 'pointer-events-none' (lines 390-405) - none are defined in the shipped stylesheet (verified), so the viewport renders inline at the end of the provider's children instead of floating. useToast silently returns a no-op context outside a provider (lines 112-122) - toasts vanish without error. Dynamic class glass-duration-[${ms}ms] (line 283) is inert. GlassToastAction/useToastActions not root-exported.
ssr: use client; document access only in effects. OK.
fake_complexity: Pause-on-hover and progress bar are present but timing math is wrong and provider timer ignores pause.
target: Single GlassToast system (merge data-display/GlassToast, feedback/GlassToast, GlassNotificationCenter)
justification: Toasts are a high-visibility surface and a natural Liquid Glass showcase, but this implementation does not float (positioning classes not shipped), dismisses at half the requested duration, runs two competing timers, announces nothing to assistive tech, and makes all types look identical. The feedback/ copy is the better-colored starting point (certification shows saturation 28 vs 0). Rebuild one toast engine with a proper queue, role=status/alert by type, reduced-motion, intent tokens and a real lensing material - then make it a flagship.

name: GlassToastProvider (re-export module)
material_impl: N/A - pure re-export of GlassToastProvider/GlassToastViewport/useToast from ./GlassToast.
motion: N/A
a11y: N/A (see GlassToast).
api: Barrel file that exists only so there is a separate story/entry; same symbols also reachable via GlassToast.
fake_complexity: Counts as a 'component' in inventories while containing no code.
justification: Nine-line re-export. Keep the public symbol names but remove the file as a separately counted component once the toast system is unified.

name: GlassTreeView
material_impl: Root OptimizedGlass with bespoke inline backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.02)' + hard-coded rgba background/border/shadow (lines 680-691), bypassing the primitive's own blur. Every node is ANOTHER OptimizedGlass card with hard-coded inline background/border/two-layer shadow and 8px margin (lines 372-404) - a tree rendered as a stack of glass cards, glass-in-glass, one backdrop surface per row. Variant classes rely on glass-surface-primary/15 etc. that are then overridden by inline background.
motion: Motion slideIn per node with delay level*50 and slideDown on children; reduced motion via useMotionPreference hook (a different hook than siblings, line 13). Sound on select/expand/check via useGlassSound.
a11y: role=tree/treeitem with aria-level/expanded/selected (good start) but NO keyboard handling at all - no arrow navigation, no Enter/Space to select, no roving tabindex: every node is tabIndex=0 plus its expand button is tabbable (lines 417, 443-456). Children not wrapped in role=group. Checkbox unlabeled (lines 463-475). Expand button lacks type=button. Interactive button nested inside treeitem.
api: forwardRef. Single selection is controlled-only: no internal selectedId state, so clicking a node in uncontrolled usage does nothing visible (lines 574-578, 642-643). handleNodeCheck looks up only top-level nodes via data.find, passing undefined for nested nodes (line 637). onDrop receives a fake {id} node (lines 298-305, comment 'simplified version'). showLines connectors use absolute children without a positioned parent offset (lines 420-435). Ships DEFAULT_TREE_DATA demo content as a default prop (lines 26-47).
fake_complexity: Drag-and-drop reorder advertised; drop callback gets a stub node and no tree mutation or keyboard alternative exists.
target: One tree primitive (merge with tree-view/TreeView, back GlassFileTree and GlassTreeSelect)
justification: Two root-exported trees (GlassTreeView and TreeView) plus GlassFileTree and GlassTreeSelect each implement their own tree. This one looks like a card list rather than a tree, puts a backdrop-filter surface on every row, lacks WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support, and has broken uncontrolled single-select and nested check handling. Consolidate into one headless tree with roving focus and a flat row material; reuse it across file tree and tree select.

name: GlassVirtualTable
material_impl: None; delegates to GlassDataTable with rows->data rename (line 25).
motion: Inherited.
a11y: Inherited.
api: Adds unused 'children' and 'disabled' props (lines 15-16) that are spread into GlassDataTable. No virtualization props (rowHeight, overscan).
fake_complexity: Named 'Virtual' but explicitly not virtualized: comment 'In a future iteration this can swap to an actual virtualized list implementation' (line 22). Large datasets render every row.
target: GlassDataTable (add a real virtualize option) / GlassDataGridPro
justification: A name that promises performance it does not deliver; consumers choosing it for large datasets will get full DOM rendering. Deprecate and add genuine windowing (e.g., virtualize prop backed by GlassVirtualList logic) to the canonical data table.

name: LiquidGlassBadgeCluster
material_impl: Shared Liquid Glass primitives: LiquidGlassMaterial (material standard, variant regular|clear, radius full) + LiquidGlassEffectGroup (lines 53-78) - the intended v5 material path. But refraction, reflection, parallax and sheen are all explicitly disabled (lines 57-63), and --glass-theme-text is hard-coded to dark slate (line 72), pinning light mode. Badge fills are hard-coded rgba white (lines 88-90).
motion: None of its own; expand/collapse is instant. Reduced-motion n/a.
a11y: aria-pressed on non-interactive <span>s (line 82) - invalid ARIA (aria-pressed requires role=button). The '+N' toggle has no aria-expanded and no accessible label beyond '+3' (lines 98-105). selectionMode only sets a data attribute (line 69) - no selection behavior.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. expanded is controlled-only with no internal state, so '+N' does nothing unless the parent wires onExpandedChange (lines 40-41, 102). No onSelectionChange. Item disabled is unused.
fake_complexity: selectionMode single/multiple advertised; no selection logic exists.
target: Liquid Glass chip group (toggle group semantics) built on LiquidGlassMaterial
justification: One of the few components on the real LiquidGlassMaterial/EffectGroup path, which is the right direction, but it disables every liquid effect, fakes selection, uses invalid ARIA and does nothing when uncontrolled. Rebuild as a proper chip/toggle group (role=group + buttons with aria-pressed, roving focus, uncontrolled expanded state) and let the material actually refract.

name: LiquidGlassCarouselRail
material_impl: Uses LiquidGlassScrollEdge primitive for soft edge fades (lines 48-52, 65-69) - good shared-primitive usage. Scroll buttons are bespoke: inline backdropFilter 'blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.04)' + hard-coded rgba border/background/shadow and 'font: 600 24px system-ui' (lines 7-23) instead of GlassButton/LiquidGlassMaterial.
motion: scrollBy behavior 'smooth' unconditionally (line 37) - ignores prefers-reduced-motion. Fixed 240px step regardless of item width.
a11y: Buttons have type=button and aria-label (good). 36x36 buttons are below 44px touch target (lines 8-9). Glyphs '‹ ›' as text. Scroller is not focusable/labelled (no tabIndex, no role=region/aria-label) so keyboard users cannot scroll content that has no focusable children. Buttons never disable at scroll ends. Items rendered with index keys.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes; items array or children. Minimal and coherent.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Small, honest component that correctly uses the LiquidGlassScrollEdge primitive and is distinct enough from the full GlassCarousel (a rail, not a paged carousel) to keep. Needs GlassButton/LiquidGlass for the controls, 44px targets, reduced-motion-aware scrolling, end-state disabling, a focusable labelled scroller, and real tests and a certification screenshot.
